messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend** periods created by Canada’s federal statutory holidays in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a three‑day stretch of Saturday–Sunday–Monday where at least one of those days is a statutory holiday.)

| Holiday | Date in 2023 | Observed (if shifted) | Long‑Weekend Dates | Notes |
|---------|--------------|-----------------------|--------------------|-------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sun) | Jan 2 (Mon) | Jan 1–3 | The holiday falls on Sunday, so the following Monday is observed. |
| Family Day (Alberta, BC, NB, ON, SK) | Feb 20 (Mon) | – | Feb 18–20 | Creates a long weekend in all participating provinces. |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Fri) | – | Apr 7–9 | Good Friday itself plus the weekend. |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Mon) | – | May 20–22 | The holiday is always on the Monday preceding May 25. |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Sat) | Jul 3 (Mon) | Jul 1–3 | Falls on Saturday, so the following Monday is observed. |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Mon) | – | Sep 2–4 | Standard first‑Monday holiday. |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 (Mon) | – | Oct 7–9 | Standard second‑Monday holiday. |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Mon) | – | Dec 23–25 | Standard holiday on Monday. |

> **Remembrance Day (Nov 11)** falls on Thursday in 2023 and is observed on Wednesday, Nov 10. It does **not** create a long weekend unless an employer offers a paid day off.  
> **Boxing Day (Dec 26)** falls on Tuesday and is observed on Wednesday, Dec 27, so it also does not create a long weekend.

These are the federal holidays that give Canadians a three‑day break in 2023. If you’re targeting a specific province, you might add provincial holidays such as St. Patrick’s Day (Ontario, Mar 17) or St. John’s Day (New Brunswick, Jun 24) which can also create long weekends depending on the year.
